title: Weekly Pipeline Report
summary: Pull HubSpot deals on a schedule, compute stage totals and week-over-week change, append to Google Sheets, generate AI commentary, and post to Slack.
trigger: Manual (set up weekly schedule with external scheduler or cron)
primaryKeyword: weekly pipeline report slack google sheets
seoTitle: Weekly Pipeline Report from HubSpot to Slack and Google Sheets
answer: This template fetches all open deals from HubSpot on a schedule you attach in Studio (for example weekly on Monday at 9 AM), computes stage-by-stage totals (count and value), calculates week-over-week change by comparing to the previous week's totals stored in Google Sheets, appends the new week's data to a Google Sheets tracking log, uses an AI agent to write a 3-line executive summary with key insights and trends, and posts the commentary plus stage breakdown to a designated Slack channel so your sales team starts the week aligned on pipeline health.

faq.q: Can HubSpot or Salesforce generate pipeline reports natively?
faq.a: Both CRMs offer pipeline dashboards and reports, but they do not combine week-over-week trend analysis, Google Sheets logging for historical tracking, AI-generated commentary, and automated Slack delivery in one workflow. This template delivers a complete, repeatable weekly pipeline ritual.

The workflow reads the previous week's totals from Google Sheets (appended by the last run), subtracts them from the current week's totals, and computes percentage change for each stage. The first run has no prior data, so changes are marked as new baseline.

Yes. Attach a schedule in Studio to change the day or time (for example, Friday afternoons instead of Monday mornings). The first run establishes a baseline with no week-over-week comparison. Subsequent runs calculate changes.

faq.q: What does the AI commentary include?
faq.a: The AI agent reads the stage totals and week-over-week changes, then writes a 3-line summary highlighting the most significant trends, for example: Pipeline grew 12% this week to $1.2M. Discovery stage up 25% with 8 new opps. Closed-Won conversion held steady at 18%.

faq.q: How do I change the Slack channel?
faq.a: Set the slack_channel input when running the playbook. You can configure this in Studio or pass it via the trigger payload.

sampleOutput: Slack message: Weekly Pipeline Report (Nov 18). Pipeline: $1.2M across 47 deals (up 12% from last week). Discovery: 15 deals / $320K (up 25%). Proposal: 18 deals / $580K (down 5%). Closed-Won: 8 deals / $240K (steady). AI insight: Strong top-of-funnel growth, but proposal stage needs attention. Built by the Brainfish team.
whatYouNeed: HubSpot integration connected, Google Sheets integration connected with a tracking sheet created, Slack Bot integration connected and invited to pipeline reports channel
failureHandling: If HubSpot, Google Sheets, or Slack API calls fail, the workflow retries automatically. Failed runs appear in history with error details. If Google Sheets is unavailable, the report posts to Slack without historical comparison.
nativeVsTemplate: Use HubSpot or Salesforce dashboards if you only need static pipeline views. Use this template when you want automated weekly reports with AI-generated insights, historical tracking in Google Sheets for trend analysis, and Slack delivery so your team sees pipeline health without logging into the CRM.
setup: Connect the HubSpot, Google Sheets, and Slack Bot integrations in Ballet once.

Create a Google Sheet with columns: Week Ending, Total Deals, Total Value, Discovery Deals, Discovery Value, Proposal Deals, Proposal Value, Closed Deals, Closed Value. Note the Sheet ID from its URL.
Invite the Slack bot to your pipeline reports channel.
Publish the playbook and run it manually, or attach a schedule in Studio (for example weekly on Monday at 9 AM).
The first run establishes a baseline with no week-over-week comparison. Subsequent weeks calculate changes.
